review_comments:
is this something stable? [the current docs says](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/reconfigure-kubelet/#generating-a-file-that-contains-the-current-configuration)

> Caution: The kubelet's configz endpoint is there to help with debugging, and is not a stable part of kubelet behavior. Do not rely on the behavior of this endpoint for production scenarios or for use with automated tools.
I'm wondering if this can add more flakiness or break in the future , but it is just a comment , not blocking anything

good call out.  `e2ekubelet.GetCurrentKubeletConfig` was essentially doing the same thing only using kubectl as an external process to open a port so this change is not adding a dependency on that endpoint but changing the way it is called.  In my runs locally I didn't see the flake with this new approach

If in the future this proves to be unstable we can revisit the approach to getting the active configuration.
